item.title: Inside the $6.34B Binance Heist: A Masterclass in APT Social Engineering
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
How did North Korean state-backed hackers orchestrate the largest cryptocurrency heist in history, targeting $6.34B from Binance? We break down the zero-day malware, fake job interviews, and EIP-7702 exploits that bypassed enterprise defenses.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The attack began as early as June, utilizing compromised development tools like Homebrew and elaborate fake recruitment interviews to achieve initial endpoint penetration. [SPLIT] ⚡ Threat actors escalated privileges by weaponizing internal AI tooling to compromise multiple engineer devices and infiltrate core wallet signing services. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/inside-the-6-34b-binance-heist-a-masterclass-in-apt-social-engineering-824893.html

item.title: Israel Weapons Industry Expands Counter-Drone Footprint into Southeast Asia
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Thailand's deployment of IWI's ARBEL counter-drone system marks a major shift in Southeast Asian defense modernization as tactical UAV threats surge.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Four additional Southeast Asian militaries are currently advancing through various stages of the ARBEL procurement process. [SPLIT] ⚡ The ARBEL system functions by replacing the lower receiver of standard infantry rifles, offering a cost-effective upgrade path without necessitating total inventory replacement.
